name: Sporthotel Austria
beschreibung:
History

The Sporthotel Austria presents itself on sporthotelaustria.at as a warmly run 4-star house. The owner is Johnny Theilersgaard, address Winterstellerweg 3, 6380 St. Johann in Tirol, telephone +43 5352 62507, email info@sporthotelaustria.at. A founding year is not given by the hotel page retrieved. The Kitzbüheler Alpen booking page describes 43 rooms on three floors, all reachable by the lift, a house with a large garden, quiet and yet central at the edge of the village. The hotel page places the house in St. Johann in Tirol, between the Wilder Kaiser and the Kitzbüheler Horn. The older region key kufstein does not appear on this page.

Getting there

The hotel page names a few minutes on foot into the centre to shops, cafés and bars and a few metres to the mountain railway Skistar St. Johann. The booking page puts figures on that: ski area about 0.2 kilometres, centre about 0.4 kilometres, swimming lake or swimming pool about 0.5 kilometres, bus stop about 0.9 kilometres, cross-country trail about 0.9 kilometres, golf course about 5.0 kilometres. A line number of the bus is not stated there. Parking is available according to the same page, plus an electric charging station for hotel guests and a bicycle storage place. The location keywords are a central and quiet location, directly on the ski piste, on the hiking path and on the cycle path.

Tips

Four room categories. The subpage on the double room with balcony describes spacious, bright double rooms with seating of about 25 square metres. The wellness area has an indoor pool of 7 by 13 metres, sauna, steam bath and infrared cabin as well as a fitness room. The garden can be used only in summer; once a week there is a barbecue evening. The lobby has an open fireplace. Activities that the hotel names for the region are skiing, snowboarding, ski and snowshoe tours, hiking on the Kitzbüheler Horn, biking and golf. The booking page also lists a lounge, a library, an e-bike battery station and internet free of charge. An example price of 121.33 euros per unit per night shown on the booking page is a portal price and not a fixed annual rate of the house. Check-in times are not on the pages retrieved.

The page on the double room with balcony, about 25 square metres, names a table, Flat-TV, carpet, bathroom with WC and hairdryer, telephone, safe and balcony. Summer prices 2026 per person per day, without the visitor’s tax of 2.60 euros: season A, including 2 May to 11 July and 22 August to 16 September, from 106.50 euros; season B, 11 July to 22 August and 16 to 20 September, from 120.50 euros. A further date line on the page is garbled and is not adopted here as a date. Winter: depending on the window from 135, 158 or 122 euros; the windows on the page run from 20 December 2025 to 21 March 2026. Children as a third person with two full-paying guests: 0 to 2 years 10 euros, 2 to 5 years 70 percent reduction, 6 to 11 years 50 percent, 12 to 15 years 20 percent. Children pay the visitor’s tax from the calendar year in which they turn 16. Included are a breakfast buffet with organic products, a 4-course evening menu with a choice and buffets, allergy menus by arrangement with the chef, once a week a barbecue evening in the garden until September and depending on the weather, bathrobes, loan bicycles and Wi-Fi. The indoor pool of 7 by 13 metres has a counter-current system. In addition sauna, steam bath, infrared cabin, garden with a sunbathing lawn only in summer, sun terrace, hall with fireplace room and hotel bar, table tennis, children’s playroom, fitness room with treadmill, cross trainer, bicycles, weight bench and power tower. Parking spaces directly at the hotel, pets on request, garage space 15 euros per day.
kurzbeschreibung: Family-run 4-star hotel of Johnny Theilersgaard, Winterstellerweg 3 in St. Johann in Tirol, with 43 rooms, an indoor pool and a small wellness area.
